sections.title: Two more, plus combining them
sections.content: barátságos ("friendly", built right on barát, "friend") and komoly ("serious") round out the set for now. Stack personality words with és the same way you already stack anything else.

items.english: My neighbor is friendly, but serious.

items.spanish: Milyen a kollégád? Szorgalmas és türelmes.
items.english: What's your colleague like? Hardworking and patient.

sections.content: barátságos -> barát is a nice free preview of the -s "having X" pattern from the last lesson: literally "having friend(liness)".
